posts.title: A Winter Son
posts.description: It’s Friday 13th, the most heavy metal of days. So today I’ve released an EP of four solo tracks from a few years ago that resurfaced and I got cleaned up a little. They’re heavy in an old school way and a little rough, maybe even unfinished feeling. But it’s been nice hearing them again […]

posts.title: Spirit Leveller
posts.description: I’ve been very low on energy, lots going on, lots to do too, but I’m also waiting for results to see if age is catching up with body if not my mind. When I saw the forecast though, I knew I had to get up and go. Linda had boiled me a couple of eggs […]

posts.title: Wave to the Waverley
posts.description: The PS Waverley passes our window near daily from spring to autumn. You hear it before you see it but it’s always a delight when it comes into view. It’s wonderful that it’s still there and still the fastest thing on the river apart for the occasional arseholes tearing up the river on a RIB. […]
